source_claim: Avatar Studios' official title-labeled timeline identifies Aang-era story characters in Avatar: The Last Airbender and Korra-era characters in The Legend of Korra. Its official character directory independently provides profiles for Aang, Appa, Azula, Iroh, Katara, Sokka, Ty Lee, Toph, and Zuko; the timeline directly names the remaining Avatar Aang and Korra cast in the corresponding series entries.
notes: Avatar Studios' official Timeline labels Avatar Aang content as 'Avatar: The Last Airbender' and separately labels Korra-era content as 'The Legend of Korra'. The former timeline directly names Aang, Katara, Sokka, Zuko, Azula, Toph, and Iroh; it describes them in entries specifically headed by Avatar: The Last Airbender: https://www.avatarstudiosofficial.com/timeline/. The official Avatar Studios character directory provides direct profiles for Aang, Katara, Toph, Sokka, Zuko, Iroh, Appa, Azula, and Ty Lee: https://www.avatarstudiosofficial.com/characters/. The Korra-era timeline directly names Korra and Asami in its Legend of Korra entry and Bolin in the Legend of Korra-era Republic City Hustle entry: https://www.avatarstudiosofficial.com/timeline/. No relation is proposed for campaign member tonraq because the checked official pages did not name/identify that exact campaign character. The broader Avatar Legends game/franchise was not used as a shortcut to assign every member to a single television Copyright.
